# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the live site at [aghirculesei.de](https://aghirculesei.de) and the current `main` branch are maintained.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue. Report it privately instead:

- [Open a private security advisory](https://github.com/MihaelaAghirculesei/Portfolio/security/advisories/new) (preferred), or
- email aghirculesei@gmail.com.

Include the affected URL or file, steps to reproduce and the impact you expect. You will get a reply within seven days.

The same contacts are published in [`/.well-known/security.txt`](https://aghirculesei.de/.well-known/security.txt).
